name: Model access
responsibility: Reads coherent content and claims, applies live updates, and sends human take-back
description:
One query cache owns each reading. A shared event connection per vault cancels obsolete requests before applying coherent snapshots. Mutable failures retain coherent content with an explicit stale indication. Exact checkpoints, state selections, comparisons, and navigation retain distinct query identities. Removed comparison definitions require the exact model, state, checkpoint, and revision. An unavailable base supplies no removed definitions.

The existing repository query resolves foreign addresses. The pane socket announces temporary explanation changes through the same tab-scoped action query. Adoption, shelving, and correction events refresh logical readings without changing exact historical addresses. Playback queries capture once and change only on explicit restart.

Preview query identity includes its saved origin, original state, and optional migration checkpoint. Preview states and checkpoints can be selected together. Preview queries refresh on mount, focus, reconnect, and explicit request without subscribing to canonical live authority. Retained reads use their exact original inputs and saved plan, including an absent plan revision. Failed selections expose recovery and never substitute current content.

Preview queries also identify the selected bookmark and exact legacy address. Playback captures the preview origin and original state together with its retained checkpoint.

The existing architecture query and event connection also discover authority for legacy panes. Only LEGACY_AUTHORITY permits a legacy reading. Installed migration catalogues remain distinct from original-preview metadata and contain no original byte envelope.
